body.goal: fix the failed v2 H2 (adaptive improver > frozen improver) with a shared continuous contextual meta-predictor trained on every candidate x probe paired outcome, a TRAIN -> META-VALIDATION -> FINAL HOLDOUT family split, and structurally distinct, diagnosis-conditioned improvement actions
body.note: append-only; every v3 dev iteration, dev-check, freeze, confirm START/END and report is recorded here, including failed and null runs

body.rule: design iteration on dev_iterate only; dev_check used only for go/no-go before freezing (every look recorded); confirm seeds never run before PREREG_FREEZE

body.label: diagnosis-after-dev05
body.note: Measured on dev seeds 3001-3004 (world 1): split-half reliability of a candidate's paired meta-val gain is r=0.47 with 48 probes/half at 600 executions/probe (0.34 at 300, 0.61 at 1500), i.e. ~0.1 on the 6 probes a round screens; per-probe noise SD ~0.23 vs true candidate-gain SD ~0.03. dev-02 ORACLE_RANK (sees true screen outcomes, not compute-matched) +1.0 vs FROZEN single-world, but -0.25 in 4-world dev-03: screen-probe gains do not transfer, the screen signal is mostly noise. dev-04 empirical-Bayes gate REJECTED: it weakened the control (FROZEN 19.67 vs 23.42 with the old gate, p=0.007) -- ADAPTIVE's apparent +1.75 was compensation for a hobbled control. dev-05 predictor-dominated finalist choice REJECTED: -2.5 vs FROZEN. Prototype deterministic best-first enumeration solver (not ledgered as a run; scratch): split-half r 0.22 progress / 0.29 solved vs EA 0.21/0.07 in the same harness, lower solve rates (COLD 0.097 vs 0.139, oracle 0.47 vs 0.60) -> noise is task heterogeneity, not search luck; prototype discarded. Decision: return to dev-03 design; tune ARM-AGNOSTIC knobs (gate, k) on FROZEN_META only; tune predictor knobs on meta_quality only.

body.label: diagnosis-after-dev08
body.note: Arm-agnostic gate sweep on FROZEN_META only (dev 3001-3012): strict 23.42, noninferior 25.17, always 26.25 (adopt best screened) -> 'always' is the strongest control and is used from dev-07 on. dev-07 (always gate): ADAPTIVE-FROZEN +0.17 (null). dev-08 pooled analysis of 3,837 randomly screened candidates (FROZEN, 24 seeds): candidate-level y variance 0.0095 of which ~0.0092 is probe noise; out-of-seed ridge R2 = 0.017 (main effects) ~ 60% of the non-noise variance -> proposal value IS learnable, but the learning curve needs ~800 candidates to reach R2>0 and ~2,800 for R2~0.012, while a 4-world run sees ~800 in total -> within-run meta-learning was data-starved. Full action x diagnosis block overfits (R2 0.007-0.014) vs main+matched (0.016). Decision: compact predictor (main effects + action x matched failure score) and longer improvement streams (more worlds per run, equal per-world budgets for every arm).

body.label: alignment-diagnostic
body.note: Dev seeds 3033-3038 (world 1, after 2 attempt rounds), 86 pool candidates: correlation between a candidate's paired META-VAL gain (60 probes) and its FINAL-holdout gain (40 tasks) = -0.045; split-half reliabilities 0.316 (meta-val) and 0.484 (final) would allow ~0.56. Mean gains are positive on both (+0.52 progress on 60 meta-val probes, +0.91 of 40 final tasks), but WHICH candidate helps most does not transfer between disjoint family sets. Implication: a meta-predictor trained on meta-val outcomes can improve the final metric only through coarse, family-independent regularities (e.g. avoiding EXPLORE). dev-10 (24 seeds, 10 worlds, always gate): ADAPTIVE-FROZEN ext +1.67 (p=0.20), in +2.33 (p=0.02), meta_quality +0.0064 (p=0.003); ADAPTIVE-NOCARRY ext +2.04 (p=0.10), meta_quality +0.0058 (p=0.005); ADAPTIVE-NODIAG ~0; adopted-candidate screen score ~0.10 in every arm (best-of-k selection on noise); ADAPTIVE adopts EXPLORE 12% vs FROZEN 19%.

GO_requires_all: ADAPTIVE_META - FROZEN_META on ext (final holdout, summed over worlds): mean > 0 and one-sided paired permutation p < 0.05
ADAPTIVE_META - ADAPTIVE_NOCARRY on ext: mean > 0 and one-sided p < 0.10
ADAPTIVE_META - FROZEN_META on meta_quality: mean > 0 and one-sided p < 0.05
per-world advantage in the second half of the worlds >= the first half (persists or grows)
